{{Quote|As I lived invisibly among them, I learned of an impending celebration, the greatest event in the Jawa calendar: the great swap meet.|[[Mammon Hoole]]|<ref name="TISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>}}
The '''Great Swap Meet''', also known as the '''Dune Sea Haggleday''', was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[swap meet]] that was held once each [[Local year|year]], just before the [[sandstorm season]], in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TISWU" />
